namespace.description: Phase 07 (Unified Policy Decision Contract). App-scoped namespace this decision was evaluated under. Defaults to `app` when the caller does not set it separately -- kept as its own field (rather than reusing `app`) so a future multi-tenant-per-app split does not need another schema revision.

consumer.description: Phase 07 (Unified Policy Decision Contract). Which of the roadmap's seven required consumer kinds produced this decision. Optional for Phase 06-era callers; every packages/policy-contract client sets it.

conditions.description: Phase 07 (Unified Policy Decision Contract). Populated only when decision is "conditional": what must additionally be true (e.g. a step-up re-authentication) before the request can proceed. Empty/absent for allow and deny, which are already final.
